title: CRM Operating System Blueprint
content:
Yes. This is the right time to stop thinking of CRM as one page and redesign it as a CRM Operating System inside the AI Center.

Your thinking is correct: the CRM should split into INDIVIDUAL LEAD MANAGEMENT and BULK LEAD OPERATIONS.

I would structure the CRM project like this:

CRM APPLICATION
│
├── 1. INDIVIDUAL LEAD MANAGEMENT
│
├── 2. BULK / MASS LEAD OPERATIONS
│
├── 3. COMMUNICATION CENTER
│
├── 4. SALES PIPELINE / CONVERSION FUNNEL
│
├── 5. CALENDAR & FOLLOW-UP SYSTEM
│
├── 6. AUTOMATION ENGINE
│
├── 7. REPORTING & ANALYTICS
│
└── 8. CRM SETTINGS
🟦 1. INDIVIDUAL LEAD MANAGEMENT

Purpose:
Everything involving one lead at a time.

Lead Profile

Every lead becomes a full CRM record.

Example:

John Smith

Status:
Hot Lead

Priority:
P1

Owner:
Sebastian

Next Action:
Call Tomorrow 10 AM
Individual Lead Actions

Buttons:

📞 Call
💬 Text
📧 Email
📅 Schedule
⭐ Change Priority
🏷 Change Category
📝 Add Note
🔄 Move Funnel Stage
Lead Communication Preferences

Every lead should have:

Preferred Communication Method:

○ Phone
○ Text
○ Email
○ WhatsApp
○ Other

Plus:

Allowed Contact Methods:

☑ Call
☑ SMS
☑ Email
☑ Automated Follow-Up

This is important because every lead is different.

🟩 2. BULK / MASS LEAD OPERATIONS

This is where the CRM becomes powerful.

Instead of:

"Work one lead"

this becomes:

"Manage thousands of leads"

Bulk Import
📥 CSV Upload

Functions:

- Upload file
- Map columns
- Preview
- Detect duplicates
- Assign categories
- Assign priority
- Import
Bulk Sorting

Examples:

Sort By:

☑ State
☑ Lead Source
☑ Resort
☑ Ownership Cost
☑ Date Created
☑ Status
☑ Priority
☑ Last Contact
☑ No Contact Attempts
Bulk Categorizing

Examples:

Select 500 leads:

Change Category:

→ Hot Leads
→ Follow Up
→ Old Leads
→ VIP
→ Spanish Speaking
→ Florida
→ No Contact
Bulk Priority Changes

Example:

Select:

250 leads

Change Priority:

P3 → P1
🟧 3. COMMUNICATION CENTER

This should be its own major section.

Because communication is the money-making engine.

Individual Communication

Inside each lead:

Communication History

Calls:
- Date
- Duration
- Recording
- Disposition

Texts:
- Sent
- Received

Emails:
- Sent
- Opened
MASS LEAD COMMUNICATIONS

Separate area:

MASS COMMUNICATION CENTER

Options:

Mass Texting
Select Leads:

☑ 1000 Florida owners

Send:

"Hi John..."

Features:

Templates
Merge fields

Example:

Hi {{first_name}},
I wanted to follow up regarding your {{resort_name}} ownership.
Mass Email

Features:

Templates
Campaigns
Tracking
Replies
Auto Dialer

Very important.

System:

Lead Queue

↓

Auto Dialer

↓

Connected?

YES
 |
Drop call recording
 |
Disposition

NO
 |
Voicemail Drop
 |
Automatic Text
 |
Automatic Email
Auto Dialer Features

Must have:

Clickless Dialing

Meaning:

No manually clicking each lead.

Flow:

Start Session

↓

Lead 1 calls

↓

Disposition

↓

Automatically calls Lead 2
Voicemail Drop

Example:

No answer:

Button:

Drop VM

Plays:

"Hi John, this is Sebastian..."

Automatic Follow-Up

Example:

No answer:

Immediately:

SMS:

Hey John, just tried calling you.
I'll follow up soon.

Email:

Subject:
Following up regarding your ownership
🟨 4. LEAD CONVERSION FUNNEL

CRM needs a visual pipeline.

Example:

NEW LEAD
   ↓
CONTACT ATTEMPTED
   ↓
CONNECTED
   ↓
QUALIFIED
   ↓
APPOINTMENT SET
   ↓
PRESENTATION
   ↓
CONTRACT SENT
   ↓
CLOSED WON
   ↓
CLOSED LOST

Kanban view:

NEW        CONTACTED       QUALIFIED       CLOSED

100          45              20              5
🟪 5. LEAD PRIORITY SYSTEM

Automatic scoring.

Example:

P0 🔴

Call immediately

Rules:

Appointment today
High ownership cost
Verified
P1 🟠

Call today

P2 🟡

Follow up

P3 🔵

Nurture

P4 ⚪

Archive

🟫 6. LEAD CALENDAR

Separate calendar:

CRM CALENDAR

Shows:

Follow-ups
Appointments
Callbacks
Tasks

Each lead can create:

Next Action:
Call Friday 2 PM
⚙️ 7. AUTOMATION ENGINE

The brain.

Examples:

IF:

Lead has no response after 3 calls

THEN:

Send text
Send email
Move to nurture
Schedule callback

IF:

Lead priority = P0

THEN:

Place at top of dialer queue
📊 8. REPORTING

Track:

Leads Uploaded

Leads Contacted

Calls Made

Connections

Appointments

Conversions

Revenue
Final CRM Architecture
CRM
│
├── INDIVIDUAL
│   ├── Lead Profile
│   ├── Lead Editing
│   ├── Scheduling
│   ├── Calling
│   ├── Texting
│   └── Emailing
│
├── BULK / MASS
│   ├── CSV Import
│   ├── Duplicate Detection
│   ├── Sorting
│   ├── Categorizing
│   ├── Bulk Priority
│   └── Mass Communication
│
├── COMMUNICATION CENTER
│   ├── Auto Dialer
│   ├── VM Drop
│   ├── Auto Text
│   ├── Auto Email
│   └── Campaigns
│
├── FUNNEL
│
├── CALENDAR
│
├── AUTOMATIONS
│
└── REPORTS

This is the correct CRM project blueprint to put into the AI Center under:

AI Center
└── CRM Platform
    └── Architecture
        └── CRM Operating System Blueprint

The next logical step would be creating this as the CRM project roadmap inside AI Center first, then building modules one at a time instead of modifying random pages.
